title: Topic 3.1: Early life of the prophet

pages.lesson:
LESSON: EARLY LIFE OF THE PROPHET

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Early life of the prophet

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Early life of the prophet. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify qualities of the Prophet prophet’s journey with his uncle (S.A.W) (S.A.W) that can be learnt from to Syria for trade. his early life. 

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify qualities of the Prophet prophet’s journey with his uncle (S.A.W) (S.A.W) that can be learnt from to Syria for trade. his early life. 
   In simple words: practise until you can identify qualities of the Prophet prophet’s journey with his uncle (S.A.W) (S.A.W) that can be learnt from to Syria for trade. his early life. . Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Early life of the prophet using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Early life of the prophet in the examples.
2. Explain Early life of the prophet to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Early life of the prophet.
4. Show that you can: Identify qualities of the Prophet prophet’s journey with his uncle (S.A.W) (S.A.W) that can be learnt from to Syria for trade. his early life. 

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Early life of the prophet using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Early life of the prophet important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners draw and colour domestic animals.
2. Learners draw their family members and colour them
3. Take up roles in school and at home to emulate the character of the Prophet S.A.W

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Identify qualities of the Prophet prophet’s journey with his uncle (S.A.W) (S.A.W) that can be learnt from to Syria for trade. his early life. 

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
